answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: every agent must lock a non-trivial, slashable stake before it can transact. Honest work then draws rewards like bees to nectar, but spinning up fakes means funding each one, so a sybil flood becomes a costly tide the attacker cannot sustain. At each dawn the protocol audits behavior and slashes stakes tied to proven duplicates, draining the cheapest path to many identities.
